decision.title: Should we add an offline export mode?
decision.summary: The available evidence supports validating an offline export before committing to a broader hosted workflow.

claims.text: An offline export is a concrete next validation for the proposed workflow.

evidence.excerpt: Local-first software gives users ownership of their data and offline capability.

nextValidation: Export one representative decision package offline and ask a reviewer to verify it on a clean machine.
limitations: Imported evidence preserves the provider result but does not prove that its sources are true, complete, authorized, or fresh.
